name: request-more-info
description: Asks the issue reporter for more information.
scriptTemplate:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
echo "Commenting on {{inputs.ref}}" >&2
COMMENT_URL=$(gh issue comment "{{inputs.ref}}" --repo "{{inputs.repository}}" --body "Thanks for the report! Could you add reproduction steps?")
jq -n --arg commentUrl "$COMMENT_URL" '{commentUrl: $commentUrl}'
